1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000020_ALISAIE
1.description: I won't bother telling you to catch your breath. Whatever brought you galloping back to us, I assume it's urgent.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000040_THANCRED
3.description: After the successful uprisings in Doma and Ala Mhigo, rebels in several other provinces were inspired to follow suit. Unfortunately, they did not fare quite so well.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000050_THANCRED
4.description: The Dalmascans paid the heaviest price. For their defiance, the Emperor made a show of razing their capital to the ground, prompting many of their neighbors to abandon thoughts of resistance.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000060_THANCRED
5.description: But not all have given up on liberty. Heartened by the news of Doma's prisoner exchange, some still believe that the Empire may one day be amenable to negotiation.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000070_THANCRED
6.description: We have the shinobi to thank for spreading the good word. They have worked tirelessly to keep the subjugated informed, and a little knowledge can go a long way.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000080_ALISAIE
7.description: There is at least a spark of hope, then.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000090_THANCRED
8.description: A spark in want of kindling, yes. The Alliance has already begun supplying materiel to resistance movements abroad, many of whom would otherwise struggle to continue the fight.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000100_THANCRED
9.description: The support effort is being led by the sultana and the Elder Seedseer, who have both seen enough Ala Mhigan refugees to know the consequences of oppression. And for their troubles, they have quickly earned a reputation as folk heroes in certain corners of the Empire.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000110_THANCRED
10.description: That is all for the provinces. As for the Garlean motherland itself...

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000120_THANCRED
11.description: Our friends the Populares have suffered something of a setback, I regret to say. Talk is rife that Doma has summoned a primal, and the Empire's more liberal voices are being drowned out in the fearful clamor for retribution.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000130_ALISAIE
12.description: And who do they think orchestrated this summoning!?

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000140_THANCRED
13.description: Oh, any but those truly responsible. Zenos has seen to that.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000150_THANCRED
14.description: Speaking of whom, the crown prince is recovering <hex:021A020203>remarkably<hex:021A020103> well. Well enough, in fact, to enable him to personally tour the provinces, putting the fear of the Emperor into the hearts of any would-be dissidents.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000160_ALISAIE
15.description: He walks in plain sight? And none suspect him? Then it's as we feared...

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000170_THANCRED
16.description: Yes. An Ascian wears his skin.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000180_THANCRED
17.description: ...But it was not that which brought me here in such haste. During my time in the provinces, I learned many things, yet at no point did I hear any report of a Doman emissary in the capital.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000190_ALISAIE
18.description: But Alphinaud should have arrived by now. Could they be holding him there in secret?

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000200_THANCRED
19.description: The possibility did cross my mind─but I have reason to believe he never reached his destination.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000210_THANCRED
20.description: As you know, Scions assigned to covert operations, such as Riol and myself, are issued special linkpearls for communication in the event of an emergency.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000220_THANCRED
21.description: I mention this because it was originally Alphinaud's task to coordinate the response at headquarters─meaning he has one. And whose voice should I hear when mine recently crackled to life...?

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000240_THANCRED
23.description: Spoke with, no. I but heard his voice─and none too clearly at that. Two words were all I could make out.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000260_ALISAIE
25.description: The wasteland on the edge of Othard? Something must have happened to them there!

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000270_ALISAIE
26.description: There's no time to waste! We must make for the Burn at once!

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000280_THANCRED
27.description: I had a feeling you might say that.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000290_ALISAIE
28.description: And? I can't very well sit around here drinking tea if Alphinaud is in trouble. You said yourself that this linkpearl was only to be used in emergencies.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000295_ALISAIE
29.description: So I'm <hex:021A020203>going<hex:021A020103>, and that's the end of it.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000300_THANCRED
30.description: Well, far be it from me to change your minds.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000335_HIEN
32.description: Between contending with bloodthirsty beasts and sand in my...every conceivable place, I'm quite ready to leave this wasteland. But first things first...

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000345_HIEN
33.description: Do you see the crashed ship over yonder?

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000355_HIEN
34.description: Judging by its class, it must be the vessel that bore Master Alphinaud away.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000370_YSHTOLA
38.description: Warmachina. It would seem they were involved in a struggle.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000380_YSHTOLA
39.description: There may be clues. We should split up and search the area.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000385_ALISAIE
40.description: There's no sign of Alphinaud. Nor of Maxima and his people.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000390_YUGIRI
41.description: Hm. These were no ordinary soldiers.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000410_YUGIRI
43.description: The insignia on this man's uniform identifies him as one of the Emperor's personal guard.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000420_YSHTOLA
44.description: Handpicked soldiers answering only to the royal family...

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000430_HIEN
45.description: That would explain why all the casualties are Garlean. They were fighting their own.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000440_ALISAIE
46.description: You're saying the Emperor was behind all this? That Alphinaud is his prisoner?

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
49.description: Alphinaud is fine, I'm sure of it.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000450_HIEN
50.description: Aye, we must not jump to conclusions. Besides, Alphinaud is more than capable of looking after himself, is he not?

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000460_YUGIRI
51.description: I suggest we return to Doma to consider our options. Whatever happened here, Master Alphinaud is long gone, and any subsequent search may safely be left in the hands of the shinobi.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000470_ALISAIE
52.description: Where in the world are you, Brother? If you die on me, I will never let you hear the end of it.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000490_LYSE
54.description: Oh, Alliance business. We have a request for Doma─well, Hien.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000500_LYSE
55.description: But that can wait. They told me you were out searching for Alphinaud. Did you manage to pick up his trail?

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000510_LYSE
56.description: Well, if he wasn't at the crash site, he might still have escaped. We have to keep searching!

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000520_HIEN
57.description: And we will. Alphinaud embarked on this journey as an emissary of Doma, and I hold myself responsible for his safe return. I will have our shinobi in the provinces search for him as a matter of urgency.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000530_HIEN
58.description: Chin up, Alisaie. You'll get to admonish your brother for his recklessness yet.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000540_ALISAIE
59.description: Well, someone has to do it.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000550_LYSE
60.description: I'm sure he's going to be fine. There is one thing I'm <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> sure about, though.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000560_LYSE
61.description: You said it was the Emperor's personal guard that attacked Alphinaud's airship.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000570_LYSE
62.description: But the Populares would never have been able to arrange the prisoner exchange without Varis's blessing. So why would he sabotage his own mission?

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000580_YUGIRI
63.description: They may not have been acting on Varis's orders. The guard answer not only to him, but to his family. The crown prince, included.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000590_HIEN
64.description: When Yotsuyu summoned Tsukuyomi, Asahi was quick to proclaim that a Doman citizen had violated the terms of our agreement. That the negotiations had failed.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000600_HIEN
65.description: And it is this version of events that is now being repeated across Garlemald. To hear the tale, one would think the prisoner exchange never took place. Plainly, someone is manipulating matters from the shadows. Most likely Zenos─or whoever it is that wears his face.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000610_YSHTOLA
66.description: Whichever Ascian, you mean. We all know the nature of our adversary.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000620_HIEN
67.description: The servants of chaos are true to their name. Their meddling has cost Doma a chance at peace.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000630_HIEN
68.description: Whoever it was that loosed his personal guard, the Emperor cannot be ignorant of these developments. We must proceed on the assumption that our treaty is indeed in tatters.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000640_HIEN
69.description: But come, Lyse, you have journeyed far. Let me hear your petition.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000650_LYSE
70.description: Right, so, the big news is that Ala Mhigo has agreed to join the Eorzean Alliance.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000660_LYSE
71.description: To make it official, and discuss where we all go from here, the leaders of the five nations are planning to hold a meeting, and we were hoping you might come too.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000670_LYSE
72.description: We've already seen what we can achieve when we work together, and the Alliance hopes to work even more closely in future. They think it's our best hope of keeping the Garleans in check─and I agree.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000680_HIEN
73.description: As do I. By coordinating our efforts in the east and west, we may be able to discourage them from committing their forces to a single front.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000690_HIEN
74.description: I accept your invitation. I must, however, ask for time to attend to some pressing matters here.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000700_HIEN
75.description: In light of recent events, the risk of imperial reprisals is greater than ever, and I would not leave Doma unguarded. Ere I depart, I must shore up her defenses.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000710_LYSE
76.description: Understood. I'll let the Alliance know.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000720_LYSE
77.description: We'll wait to hear from you before setting a date. The meeting's to be held at the Royal Palace in Ala Mhigo, incidentally. Do you remember the way?

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000730_HIEN
78.description: Well enough. Please assure my hosts that I will not keep them waiting any longer than I have to.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000740_LYSE
79.description: Consider it done! And thank you for agreeing to come. If we all put our heads together, we're sure to find the best way forward. For everyone.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000750_YUGIRI
80.description: If we are to ready ourselves for invasion, we shall need manpower, provisions, and time. All of which are in notably short supply.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000760_HIEN
81.description: Candid as ever, Yugiri. And correct, I concede. Fortunately, I have an idea.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000770_HIEN
82.description: 'Tis plain no single nation can stand against the might of the Empire.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000780_HIEN
83.description: And it was only with the aid of others that Doma succeeded in winning her freedom. So I mean to take a leaf out of our Eorzean friends' book and form an alliance of our own.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000790_HIEN
84.description: In addition to those with whom we already share an understanding, I would reach out to Hingashi and Sui-no-Sato, and further afield, to the myriad peoples of Nagxia and Dalmasca.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000800_HIEN
85.description: I am under no illusion─not all will answer the call. Yet disparate though we may be, we are united in our desire for freedom.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000810_HIEN
86.description: If our neighbors could be made to see what is at stake─Ascian machinations and all─cooperation need not be so far-fetched a notion.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000830_YSHTOLA
88.description: Under the guidance of our former leader, Master Louisoix, we once strove to unite the fractious city<hex:021F0103>states of Eorzea. I daresay that experience shall be of use in your endeavor.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000840_HIEN
89.description: We should be glad of your wisdom.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000850_ALISAIE
90.description: For the record, I would have been in favor of this plan, even if it <hex:021A020203>hadn't<hex:021A020103> been my grandfather's, but I have to ask: how will we secure the time to carry it out?

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000860_ALISAIE
91.description: Not that anyone has forgotten, but the Garleans have airships. Lots and lots of airships. Should they catch wind of our plan, they could send an armada to overwhelm us before our alliance had even begun to take shape.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000870_YSHTOLA
92.description: ...Not if we deny them access to the skies.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000880_YSHTOLA
93.description: During our time in the Burn, the Warrior of Light and I chanced upon some Allagan ruins.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000900_YSHTOLA
95.description: As such ruins go, they were not particularly unusual, but something about the surrounding land struck me as odd. Faint though it was, its aetherial residue was uncannily similar to that of Azys Lla. Identical, in fact.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000910_YSHTOLA
96.description: For locations so far removed to share a single aetheric signature is all but impossible. I conclude therefore that the Allagans created the floating continent with land taken from the Burn.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000920_YUGIRI
97.description: While that is a most intriguing theory, I fail to see what relevance it has to Doma's defense.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000930_YSHTOLA
98.description: Azys Lla was enclosed in a powerful energy barrier, impenetrable even to an Agrius-class battleship.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000940_YSHTOLA
99.description: It occurred to me that those ruins may have enjoyed similar protection. I have no proof, but the Warrior of Light <hex:021A020203>did<hex:021A020103> report seeing a structure resembling other known Allagan field generators.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000950_YSHTOLA
100.description: It occurred to me that those ruins may have enjoyed similar protection. I have no proof, but the Warrior of Light <hex:021A020203>did<hex:021A020103> report seeing a structure resembling other known Allagan field generators.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000960_ALISAIE
101.description: All right, but even if we could put up such an energy barrier, it surely wouldn't extend beyond the limits of the Burn. So what's to stop the Garleans flying around it?

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000970_HIEN
102.description: ...Fuel. The Dalmascan capital, Rabanastre, was a key imperial refueling point in the East. By laying waste to it as a lesson to the rest, the Empire greatly hindered its own operations in the region.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_000980_HIEN
103.description: If an imperial fleet were to advance upon Doma, it would now have little choice but to travel as the crow flies─over the Burn.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001000_YSHTOLA
105.description: A word of caution. Even assuming the generator still functions, raising a barrier of such a scale will require a prodigious amount of energy.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001010_YSHTOLA
106.description: And few places are so bereft of suitable crystals as the Burn.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001030_HIEN
108.description: Tell me, did the Allagans make a habit of launching things into the sky?

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001040_YSHTOLA
109.description: A curious question. Besides Azys Lla, I know of only one other notable instance: the red moon Dalamud, whose fall triggered the Calamity.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001050_HIEN
110.description: Just the two occasions, you say... Then I believe I may have a solution to our energy problem.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001070_HIEN
112.description: I <hex:021A020203>may<hex:021A020103>. To find out for sure, we would need to visit the Azim Steppe.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001080_HIEN
113.description: ...Which would, I now see, present the perfect opportunity to discuss an alliance with the Xaela tribes. How very neat! What say you, then? Shall we see whither this road leads?

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001090_HIEN
114.description: Ahhh, I will never tire of this vista! The endless fields, the boundless skies... 'Tis a sight to make a man forget his cares.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001100_YSHTOLA
115.description: But not his purpose, I trust.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001110_YSHTOLA
116.description: Might this be a fitting moment to tell us what we are doing here?

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001120_HIEN
117.description: Of course. During my time with the Mol, I learned some few myths of this land. One goes thus...

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001130_HIEN
118.description: “In the distant past, when all seemed doomed, a wayfaring soul came unto the steppe. Venturing into the northern crag, he received of Nhaama a sliver of her essence─a shard of the shining moon─and with it clove the tainted land from the earth.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001140_HIEN
119.description: “The end thus averted, to these fields did the wayfaring soul return. And venturing once more into the northern crag, he buried the shard, and made unto the heavens an offering of blood.”

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001150_YSHTOLA
120.description: A tainted land cloven from the earth, and an offering of blood to the heavens... Azys Lla and Dalamud.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001170_YSHTOLA
122.description: And you believe that yonder mountains hide an artifact possessed of sufficient power to raise Azys Lla up to the heavens. ...I suppose that might suffice.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001180_HIEN
123.description: Worth a closer look, would you say?

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001220_YSHTOLA
127.description: We are. This is an Allagan artifact, most likely built to regulate the flow of aether.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001230_YSHTOLA
128.description: I strongly suspect the ancients used it to stem the flow from here to the Burn. That would explain how they were able to untether what became Azys Lla from its surroundings.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001240_YSHTOLA
129.description: But were we to throw open the floodgates, the resultant deluge would surely be sufficient to raise our wall. And in restoring the flow, we may also restore life to the wasteland.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001270_YSHTOLA
132.description: While the device itself harbors a surfeit of aether, the opposite is true of the surrounding area...

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001280_YSHTOLA
133.description: An effect of regulation, perhaps? A similar phenomenon seemed to be occurring in Doma...

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001290_YSHTOLA
134.description: Whatever the explanation, the answer will not reveal itself here. We have seen what we needed to see. Let us return to Mol Iloh.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001300_SADU
135.description: Yes, this spot shall serve as well as any. I shall enjoy this, khagan!

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001310_YSHTOLA
136.description: Is this truly necessary? Have you no peaceable way of making decisions?

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001320_SADU
137.description: Speak not of peace. You stand before proud warriors of the Dotharl. In the heat of battle do our souls burn brightest!

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001330_SADU
138.description: We lay low the strong that we may rise higher!

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001335_SADU
139.description: That is our way─the way of might! There is no other!

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001340_YSHTOLA
140.description: ...Well, they do not want for conviction.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001350_HIEN
141.description: Indeed. It's what makes them such dangerous enemies...and such useful allies.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001360_SADU
142.description: Enough talk! It is time to fight!

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001370_SADU
143.description: Yes! YES! Not since the Naadam has my soul burned so!

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001380_SADU
144.description: Come! We have only just begun!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001390_MAGNAI
145.description: Enough. You were not granted leave to set the Steppe ablaze.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001400_HIEN
146.description: Well, well! The sun has come out to play!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001410_SADU
147.description: Begone, moonstruck Oronir! I am busy.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001420_MAGNAI
148.description: Fool of a Dotharl. Have you forgotten the face of your master already? The Sun will never set! From his seat on high, he reigns over all, now and forever!

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001430_MAGNAI
149.description: Yet what should he find here but a battle to determine the fate of the Steppe─a battle waged without his blessing! This will not stand!

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001440_MAGNAI
150.description: You, Doman. You who come to petition the warriors of this land forget that all Nhaama's children are wards of the Oronir. As first among my brothers, your petition is mine alone to judge.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001450_SADU
151.description: These words are as wind from a horse's backside. Plentiful. But your axe sings more sweetly. Let her speak for you.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001460_MAGNAI
152.description: Insolent child. You will learn your place.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001470_HIEN
153.description: Forgive me, Brother Magnai, but we have an arrangement with the Dotharl. We will not abide any interruptions.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001480_MAGNAI
154.description: So be it. The Sun will pass judgment on all. Daidukul─join me.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001485_SADU
155.description: The Sun is in good company. We may dance alone.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001490_MAGNAI
156.description: Beg not for mercy, for you will have none. Bear witness to the power and the glory of Azim!

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001500_YSHTOLA
157.description: Constantly at each other's throats, like rabid...dogs. Gods, I'm turning into her.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001510_YSHTOLA
158.description: Ahem. I have not the patience for this. But if we must fight, let us at least be brief. Come!

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001515_SYSTEM
159.description: In the coming battle, you will fight as Y'shtola.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001520_SADU
160.description: Ahhh, never have I felt such bliss in defeat!

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001530_SADU
161.description: 'Twas a battle to burn soul and flesh to ash. We Dotharl will lend you our strength as promised. Nhaama's power is yours to wield.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001540_SADU
162.description: What does the Sun say to that?

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001550_MAGNAI
163.description: Hmph. The Sun is not driven by base motives such as yours. But aye, they have been judged...and found worthy.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001560_MAGNAI
164.description: It is the way of the Oronir to accord recognition and respect to the strong. You have made sufficient proof of your strength. The Sun shall answer your call.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001570_HIEN
165.description: You have our thanks. We are glad to call you allies.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001580_MAGNAI
166.description: You. By what are you called?

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001630_MAGNAI
171.description: In battle, you shone with all the majesty of the full moon's light, your healing touch the embodiment of the Dusk Mother's love.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001640_MAGNAI
172.description: Long had I wondered if my Nhaama might not be a woman of the Steppe. Beholding you, I am all but certain!

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001650_MAGNAI
173.description: Now, look into my eyes. Could it be...? Could you be...?

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001660_YSHTOLA
174.description: I am...not interested, little sun. Try again when you have become a man.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001700_SADU
178.description: Does it pain you, little sun? Crave you salve to soothe the ache? Fire to sear the wound in your heart?

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001710_YSHTOLA
179.description: We have wasted enough time here. Cirina waits for word of our success.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001730_YSHTOLA
181.description: It did. Aether may flow freely to the Burn once more.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001740_NANAMOULNAMO
182.description: Mistress Lyse. Commander Aldynn. It gives me great pleasure to formally welcome the city-state of Ala Mhigo to the Eorzean Alliance.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001750_RAUBAHN
183.description: The pleasure is ours, Your Grace. I know I speak for all Ala Mhigans when I say that we are glad of this chance to stand with our comrades of the Alliance.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001760_KANESENNA
184.description: And we for our part are glad indeed to be able to welcome friends both old and new...

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001770_HIEN
185.description: Lord Hien of Doma, at your service. Pray accept my heartfelt thanks for your generous invitation.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001780_AYMERIC
186.description: Nay, 'tis we who must thank you for journeying so far. And 'twould be remiss of me not to acknowledge the part the Scions of the Seventh Dawn have played in bringing all of us together.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001790_AYMERIC
187.description: In times of great unrest, you and yours have been our constant companions, without whom we would not be here.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001800_NANAMOULNAMO
188.description: With apologies to Lord Hien and Mistress Alisaie, it occurs to me that we have not gathered in this way since that fateful day in Ul'dah.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001810_RAUBAHN
189.description: The day I lost my arm and my freedom... As I lay in my cell, never did I dream that I would one day be given the chance to represent my homeland at this council.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001820_RAUBAHN
190.description: I would not even be alive had you not plucked me from the jaws of death─you, Yugiri, and Alphinaud. Would that the lad could be with us...

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001830_ALISAIE
191.description: I too owe my presence here to Alphinaud. In so many ways... Until such time as he returns, I mean to carry on his good work as best I can.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001840_NANAMOULNAMO
192.description: Come, friends─let us leave the past in the past, and turn our eyes to the future. My lord Hien, pray tell us how things stand in the East.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001850_KANESENNA
193.description: Having heard the rumors of dissent in Garlemald, I dared to dream of a peaceable solution...

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001860_MERLWYB
194.description: Hm. The Empire will not so easily change its ways.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001870_MERLWYB
195.description: If the Garleans have a mind to take back Doma and Ala Mhigo, we'll be hard-pressed to stop them. Even with the might of six nations.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001880_MERLWYB
196.description: But while we lack the strength to fight the tide, a course may yet present itself if we read the winds aright.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001890_AYMERIC
197.description: The winds suggest but one course to me─one which leads from the sea unto the river and thence to the source of all our woes.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001910_AYMERIC
199.description: Indeed. All here have felt their blighted touch. It was the Bringers of Chaos who nurtured the archbishop's tyrannical ambitions...

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001920_AYMERIC
200.description: They who bestowed upon him the secrets of summoning, as they have so many others, before and since. And while they remain, we shall know no peace.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001930_RAUBAHN
201.description: Our objective is clear. The question is how to achieve it. That our enemy parades about in Zenos's skin poses problems in itself, but ere we get to them, how are we to infiltrate the Empire and get close enough to strike?

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001940_THANCRED
202.description: While I see the wisdom in targeting the Ascians, an assassination attempt on Garlean soil would do little to aid our cause...even were it to succeed. It's time we used our enemy's preferred tactic: subterfuge.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001960_MERLWYB
204.description: Speak your mind, Master Thancred. None here know the enemy better than the Scions, and you mayhap best of all.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001970_MERLWYB
205.description: Whatever it is you propose, we will give it fair hearing. On that you have my word.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001980_THANCRED
206.description: Very well, Admiral. My proposal is thus.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_001990_THANCRED
207.description: We dispatch the shinobi to imperial territory. There, they sow the rumor that the crown prince perished in the battle for Ala Mhigo, and that the man parading around is in fact a corpse inhabited by a servant of darkness.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002000_RAUBAHN
208.description: Well...it does have the ring of truth about it. And were the Garleans to learn that their future ruler is a puppet, the Empire would be shaken to the core.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002010_LYSE
209.description: But─at the risk of sounding stupid─would they actually believe such an unlikely story? I didn't.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002020_THANCRED
210.description: Ordinarily not. But prior to his miraculous recovery, rumors of Zenos's death had already begun to circulate around the Empire.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002030_THANCRED
211.description: Ultimately, however, what the masses believe is not our chief concern. Our true objective is to create an opening for rival factions within Garlemald to exploit.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002040_HIEN
212.description: Just as a war of succession erupted in the wake of Emperor Solus's death!

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002050_THANCRED
213.description: A war which raged until but recently, plunging the imperial house into disarray as nephew and uncle grappled for the throne.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002060_THANCRED
214.description: It is no coincidence that one of Varis's first acts as Emperor was to name Zenos heir apparent─family feuds being so tiresome when armies are involved. Not all welcomed his choice of successor, however.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002070_THANCRED
215.description: There is no shortage of individuals who aspire to the throne─who would jump at any chance to seize power. The news that Zenos is not only dead, but a puppet to diabolical forces, would be too enticing to ignore.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002080_HIEN
216.description: The Empire would not be quick to recover from a second war of succession.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002090_THANCRED
217.description: I am no stranger to infiltrating imperial territory. With a team of operatives gathered from among the Alliance's finest, the plan should have a reasonable chance of success.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002100_HIEN
218.description: Doma already has shinobi in place throughout the provinces. We stand ready to act, and act we must. What say you all?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002110_MERLWYB
219.description: I am for Master Thancred's proposal. We shine a light upon the Ascian and test the Empire's unity.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002120_MERLWYB
220.description: 'Twas his plot that scuttled Doma's negotiations, was it not? Why then, if we can eliminate him, there may yet be a chance for peace.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002130_MERLWYB
221.description: Let us wage this war of subterfuge, that we may one day lay down our arms. Gods know, we never will while the Ascians remain.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002170_MYSTERYVOICE
228.description: Ahead looms Light, expunging all form and life.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002180_MYSTERYVOICE
229.description: Twin dooms only you can forestall. Only you.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002220_KANESENNA
233.description: Nay. I sense no such presence.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002230_MYSTERYVOICE
234.description: Let expanse contract, eon become instant...

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002240_MYSTERYVOICE
235.description: Throw wide the gates that we may pass!

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002280_KANESENNA
239.description: Bear him to a private chamber. Have every healer make ready.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002300_RESISTANCEHEALER
241.description: Master Thancred remains in slumber. Though his vital signs appear stable, he is unresponsive.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002310_LYSE
242.description: What could have done this? And why just him and not the others?

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002320_RESISTANCEHEALER
243.description: I'm afraid we could not identify the cause, my lady. Our examinations revealed no wounds, nor the presence of any poisonous substances...

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002330_LYSE
244.description: Gods, that only makes it worse. You're to let us know the moment there's any change, all right?

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002340_ALISAIE
245.description: Thank you for coming. Knowing Thancred, he would apologize for being otherwise engaged at so crucial a juncture.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002350_KANESENNA
246.description: In gifting us a course of action, Thancred sowed the seed of all that is to follow. We have but to nurture it as best we can. To him I would say rest easy, that he may wake to enjoy the fruits of our labors.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002360_KANESENNA
247.description: Now, the matter of the mysterious voice must not be forgotten. Will you tell me exactly what happened?

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002370_YSHTOLA
248.description: Alisaie and I heard a voice in the moments before Thancred collapsed. It was accompanied by a severe headache─as if something were clutching at our minds. Did you experience the same thing?

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002380_ALISAIE
249.description: ...So, in between the voice and the pain, you felt as if you were somewhere else entirely?

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002390_KANESENNA
250.description: Your testimony confirms my suspicion. That which you experienced was, I believe, your soul being plucked from your flesh. <hex:021A020203>Called<hex:021A020103>.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002420_KANESENNA
253.description: Reach out as I may, I could not sense in him the spark of life that is his soul.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002430_KANESENNA
254.description: That Thancred alone was stricken so is likely due to his heightened sensitivity to the effects of aether─a consequence of his prior possession by the Ascian Lahabrea.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002440_KANESENNA
255.description: The owner of the voice, whoever it may be, reached out to you─called your souls─and in so doing caused you and yours such pain.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002450_ALISAIE
256.description: But...if that's true, where exactly are we being called <hex:021A020203>to<hex:021A020103>?

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002460_KANESENNA
257.description: I know not. Yet one thing is plain: whoever waits for you on the other side is possessed of a power unlike any I have ever known.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002470_YSHTOLA
258.description: Forgive us, Lyse, but may we leave Thancred in your care for a time?

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002480_LYSE
259.description: As if you had to ask. I may not be a Scion anymore, but I'm no less a friend.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002490_LYSE
260.description: Don't worry, I'll see to it that Thancred's well looked after. Just focus on solving this mystery, all right?

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002510_YSHTOLA
262.description: As the Elder Seedseer says, 'tis no ordinary individual we are dealing with. Nor can we discount the possibility of Ascian involvement.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002520_ALISAIE
263.description: Whoever or whatever is behind this, the sooner we find out the better.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002530_ALISAIE
264.description: Urianger! Gods it's good to see you!

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002540_URIANGER
265.description: Would that our meeting were under happier circumstances. I judged the voice sufficient cause for concern even before you sent word of its effect on our comrade...

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002560_URIANGER
267.description: Aye. And all but certainly at the selfsame instant. Alas, pained as I was, I could make little sense of what few words did then reach mine ears.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002570_YSHTOLA
268.description: Who do you think is responsible? Could this be the Ascians' doing?

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002580_URIANGER
269.description: That I cannot say. Not when so little is known.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002590_URIANGER
270.description: Ere I indulge in speculation, I would examine Thancred with mine own eyes.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002600_ALISAIE
271.description: To Ala Mhigo, then─without further delay!

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002610_YSHTOLA
272.description: One other thing. During my visit to the Far East, I observed a strange phenomenon.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002620_URIANGER
273.description: Thou referest, I presume, to the localized reduction in aetheric density?

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002630_YSHTOLA
274.description: Well, that spares me the trouble of an explanation. Yes. I noted precisely that at two apparently unconnected locations. I take it the phenomenon is not limited to the Far East?

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002640_URIANGER
275.description: Indeed not. Of late, our agents charged with surveilling the beast tribes have spoken of little else. In every corner of the realm, they tell of places in which the aether hath grown thin.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002650_URIANGER
276.description: Naturally, my suspicions first turned to primal activity, but the areas thus affected betray no evidence of summoning. I must confess to being quite perplexed.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002660_YSHTOLA
277.description: If the same phenomenon is being observed in multiple locations on opposite sides of the world, we may safely discount regional factors. Needless to say, this warrants further investigation.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002670_URIANGER
278.description: Indeed. I shall make it my task to─

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002680_URIANGER
279.description: The voice... It calleth to me once more...

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002740_ALISAIE
285.description: No! NO! This can't be happening!

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002760_ALISAIE
287.description: Open your eyes, I beg you...

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002770_ALISAIE
288.description: Say something...anything... Not again... Please! Not again!

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002800_MAELSTROMOFFICER
292.description: I'm afraid there has been no change. If he can see or hear us, he has given no sign...

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002830_ALISAIE
295.description: We promised that we would come and visit you together, didn't we. Alphinaud and I. I'm sorry that we haven't managed that yet.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002840_ALISAIE
296.description: You know, with the three of us like this, does it not remind you of that night? Of the stars beyond count, twinkling in the heavens?

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002850_ALISAIE
297.description: I was feeling pretty low back then. Powerless. But I knew that my brother was close by if I needed him. And that the others would be waiting for me back at the Rising Stones.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002870_ALISAIE
299.description: I've seen my share of trouble since coming to Eorzea.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002875_ALISAIE
300.description: ...Been reminded again and again of my limitations─of how little I can change about this world. And I've come to know the sorrow of parting all too well.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002880_ALISAIE
301.description: But to have the people I hold dear struck down before my eyes, and be powerless to help them...? That─ That I cannot bear.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
304.description: You don't have to bear this burden alone.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002890_ALISAIE
305.description: And for that I am grateful. I don't know what I'd do without you.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002900_ALISAIE
306.description: ...No. I don't. You're right. It's pure arrogance to imagine I can solve everything by myself. You'd think I'd have learned that by now. Thank you. I don't know what I'd do without you.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002910_ALISAIE
307.description: Well, that's more than enough brooding for one day.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002920_ALISAIE
308.description: Come on. We have friends to save.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002930_ROBEMAN
310.description: (-Zenos-)The Populares no longer present an obstacle. Now is the time to bring the Empire's might to bear.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002940_ROBEMAN
311.description: (-Zenos-)A word from Your Radiance is all it takes. But <hex:021A020203>one word<hex:021A020103>, and the imperial army will fall upon Ala Mhigo as a pack of bloodthirsty wolves and tear that feeble nation apart.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002960_ROBEMAN
313.description: (-Zenos-)Despite the lengths I go to─an emissary, playing the part of a fool.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002970_ROBEMAN
314.description: (-Zenos-)When first I took this face, I swore to use all of my knowledge, all of my power, to further the cause of the Empire. My deeds stand testament to my commitment.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_002980_ROBEMAN
315.description: (-Zenos-)And with this adamant flesh at my disposal, I could destroy the eikon-slayer as easily as one might swat a fly. Why do you hesitate?

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003000_ROBEMAN
317.description: (-Zenos-)Our enemy is resourceful. Though victory is certain now, it will not remain so indefinitely. Deliberate if you must, but be quick about it. We will speak again when you have unburdened yourself of doubt. Until then, I take my leave...Father.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003010_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
318.description: (-???-)I should be the one to sigh.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003020_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
319.description: (-???-)I played my part to perfection. I had earned my rest. And then, thanks to Lahabrea's crowning act of idiocy, our favorite emissary sees fit to summon me back.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003030_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
320.description: (-???-)Elidibus was ever a worrier. A most tiresome trait, would you not agree?

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003040_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
321.description: (-???-)What, have you no words for me either? No matter. I've long grown weary of this mummery.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003050_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
322.description: (-???-)Now, my dearest grandson. Let me remind you of your place, in the simplest of terms.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003060_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
324.description: (-???-)You do not make judgments─you administer them. Swiftly and to the letter. Naught else is your concern.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003070_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
325.description: (-???-)Elidibus may be an insufferable bore, but he is no fool. His choices as emissary seldom err.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003080_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
326.description: (-???-)If aught threatens the balance 'twixt Light and Dark, it falls to you to remove it.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003090_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
327.description: (-???-)Be it by your own hands or by your armies, you have ample means at your disposal.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003100_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
328.description: That is why this empire exists─why <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> built it.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003110_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
329.description: Oh dear. Have I touched a nerve? You always were an easy one to read.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003120_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
330.description: I pity you, I do. As they say, ignorance is bliss. And I know how much happier you would be not knowing the things you know.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003130_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
331.description: The founding father was an Ascian! And he created the Empire solely for the purpose of sowing the seeds of chaos!

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003140_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
332.description: Don't take it personally. I merely do my duty.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003150_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
333.description: To bring about a Calamity requires no small amount of power. And there is no surer way to obtain such power than by collecting powerful pawns.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003160_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
334.description: To that end, I have labored long and hard, and I must say I am quite pleased with my handiwork─paltry though it seems in comparison to Allag.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003170_VARIS
335.description: You fiends are overfond of your own voices.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003180_VARIS
336.description: Mark me, Ascian. Man is the master of his own destiny!

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003200_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
338.description: Such a waste of time and energy. Both yours and mine.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003210_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
339.description: Lest you forget, you are Emperor now. If you wish to spout drivel about man's destiny, save it for the masses. It will serve to give them a sense of purpose...and you pliant pieces for the game.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003220_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
340.description: Oh, do stop sulking, boy. You of all people should understand.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04400_003230_SOLUSZOSGALVUS
341.description: Ours is a struggle to restore both mankind and the world to their rightful state. Viewed thus, our goals are one and the same.
